subtitle: Lesson 17 · Training Deep Networks in Practice

code:
import torch.nn as nn

conv_block = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Conv2d(3, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
    nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
    nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
)
caption: Normalizes per channel across the batch dimension.

code:
import torch.nn as nn

layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(normalized_shape=512)

x = torch.randn(16, 10, 512)
# (batch, seq_len, features)
normalized = layer_norm(x)
caption: Normalizes over the feature dimension -- no batch-size dependence.
